name: test_the_committed_spec_is_what_the_implementation_generates
message:
AssertionError: api/worker/openapi.yaml no longer matches the implementation. Run `python api/worker/openapi.py` and commit the result.
assert '# GENERATED ...b67e121e42}\n' == '# GENERATED ...6e5f3bf838}\n'
  
  Skipping 567 identical leading characters in diff, use -v to show
  - version 1-79cf5b6e5f3bf838). Call decide early with a template-based Spec; refine
  ?           ^^^ ^   ^^^^^^^^
  + version 1-31f80fb67e121e42). Call decide early with a template-based Spec; refine
  ?           ^^ ^^^  + ^^^^^^
        from reading and recovery hints.
    
    
        Use when choosing, switching, or checking a model before a task or deploy. POST /v1/decide takes your requirements and returns the models that fit, with reasons,
        cost per task and ties; when nothing fits, it says what to relax. POST /v1/rank is deprecated: the retired fixed-benchmark ranking, kept for existing callers
        and never a fallback for decide. POST /v1/policy-check returns, per model and per platform, pass, fail or undetermined against a licence, origin, residency and
        commercial-use policy, citing the document behind each verdict. After you act on an answer, POST /v1/feedback with a rating (reliable, unreliable, trustworthy,
        untrustworthy, confusing) and its decision_id; no key.
    
    
        One call, and no state on your side. Each answer is computed per request from the current public export; `build.commit` on every response names the catalogue
        it was computed from. A request carries a profile or a policy — never a prompt.
    
    
        Machine data access needs an API key (see x-modelspec-access). GET /v1/health and POST /v1/feedback stay keyless. The free decide page uses the human browser
        visit gate, with a Turnstile-verified visit token for decide and vocabulary when VISIT_GATE_ENABLED is on. Any key starting `test_` is the sandbox: unlimited,
        synthetic rows from the real scorer, /v1/rank only.
    
    
        Without a paid entitlement, policy-check uses public-export evidence. Every check it cannot settle is `undetermined` with `why: tier`, and `determinations.undetermined_for_lack_of_entitlement`
        counts them. It is never a pass.
    
    
        Any common HTTP client `User-Agent` works, including Python''s default (`Python-urllib/*`). A `403` with the non-JSON body `error code: 1010` is a refusal at
        the Cloudflare edge, not from this service. Report it.
    
    
        Reference: docs/api.md and docs/api-policy-check.md. Generated from the implementation by api/worker/openapi.py.'
      license: {name: MIT, url: 'https://github.com/turbobeest/modelspec'}
      x-error-codes: [access_not_configured, access_store_not_configured, comparison_snapshot_changed, comparison_snapshot_unavailable, credits_store_not_configured,
        determinations_unavailable, explanation_unavailable, export_unavailable, human_burst_limit, human_challenge_required, human_day_limit, human_gate_unavailable,
        human_intent_limit, human_origin_required, human_sweep_limit, insufficient_evidence, invalid_api_key, invalid_request, invalid_spec, key_revoked, method_not_allowed,
        missing_api_key, no_match, no_snapshot, not_found, origin_not_allowed, payload_too_large, payment_required, rate_limited, sandbox_not_available, snapshot_changed,
        snapshot_not_loaded, snapshot_refused, snapshot_unavailable, tier_not_configured, undetermined_present, unknown_hardware, unknown_hosting, unknown_model, unknown_platform,
        unknown_runtime, unknown_use_case, visit_token_expired, visit_token_invalid]
      x-transport-error-statuses: {export_unavailable: 502, human_burst_limit: 429, human_challenge_required: 403, human_day_limit: 429, human_gate_unavailable: 503,
        human_intent_limit: 429, human_origin_required: 401, human_sweep_limit: 429, method_not_allowed: 405, not_found: 404, origin_not_allowed: 404, visit_token_expired: 401,
        visit_token_invalid: 401}
      x-max-request-bytes: {/v1/rank: 16384, /v1/decide: 65536, /v1/compare: 65536, /v1/compare-models: 65536, /v1/policy-check: 262144, /v1/signals: 4096, /v1/signals/discovered: 4096,
        /v1/feedback: 4096}
    x-modelspec-access:
      status: wired; enforced
      ticket: MODEL-69
      enforced: true
      switch: ACCESS_ENFORCED in api/worker/wrangler.jsonc
      key_store_bound: true
      effect_today: 'Every machine data endpoint needs an API key: a request without one is refused 401 missing_api_key, naming https://modelspec.dev/pricing. GET /v1/health
        and POST /v1/feedback stay keyless. The free decide page uses the human browser visit gate: with VISIT_GATE_ENABLED, a Turnstile-verified visit token admits only
        decide and vocabulary for its bound visitor and origin. The ACCESS key store is bound. Existing live keys are checked against it; test_ keys use the sandbox.'
      policy_check_paid_entitlement: {status: 'granted to a presented key with remaining credits, or a credit-exempt paid tier', granted_by: 'entry.py::_entitlement',
        effect_today: 'Public-export evidence has determinations.entitlement public_export; checks they cannot settle come back undetermined with why: tier and available_in_tier:
          paid. A funded key reads the determinations, or gets HTTP 503 determinations_unavailable when the store cannot be read. A credit-exempt paid tier also reads
          the determinations without a balance. Other keys with zero credits get the public-export answer plus credits.exhausted.'}
      present_key_as: ['Authorization: Bearer <key>', 'X-API-Key: <key>']
      never: a key in the query string

        friends: {daily_limit: null, burst_limit_per_minute: 60, live_data: true, description: 'Friends and family: live paid access without credit charges. No daily

              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              properties:
                name: {description: 'Optional label, echoed back.', type: string, nullable: true}

                  additionalProperties: false
                  properties:
                    allowed:

                      items: {type: string, minLength: 1}
                    prohibited_countries:
                      type: array
                      nullable: true
                      items: {type: string, minLength: 1}
                residency:
                  description: 'Regions spelled as the platform publishes them. Matched literally: no country is mapped onto a cloud region.'
                  type: object
                  additionalProperties: false
                  required: [required_regions]
                  properties:
                    required_regions:
                      type: array
                      minItems: 1
                      items: {type: string, minLength: 1}
                    match:
                      type: string
                      enum: [any, all]

                  additionalProperties: false
                  properties:
                    required:
                      type: boolean
                      nullable: true
                      enum: [true, null]

            require_no_undetermined: {description: true turns any undetermined row into a 422 undetermined_present instead of a 200., type: boolean, nullable: true, default: false}
            models:

              type: array
              nullable: true
              items: {type: string, minLength: 1}
              maxItems: 500
            platforms:
              description: Platform ids to check on; omit for every listed one.
              type: array
              nullable: true
              items:
                type: string

            limit: {description: Pages result only; summary is never paged., type: integer, minimum: 0, maximum: 500, default: 50}
            offset: {type: integer, minimum: 0, default: 0}
        PolicyCheckResponse:
          type: object

                returned: {type: integer}

                    type: string

              required: [limit, matching_rows, offset, returned, truncated, verdicts_shown]
            policy:

              type: object
              properties:
                constraints:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    commercial_use: &id061

                        required: {type: boolean}

                          items: {type: string}

                          items: {type: string}

                    residency: &id062

                          type: array
                          items: {type: string}

                  type: object
                  properties:

              required: [by_constraint, models_checked, models_undetermined_somewhere, models_with_a_passing_platform, rows, verdicts]

        PolicyRow:

message:
subprocess.CalledProcessError: Command '['bash', '-e', '-c', '# Holding must derive from the untouched full build above. Live is a
# whitelist (pipeline/live.py) so a new v1 page cannot reappear merely
# by being generated, and it fails if llms.txt, the Markdown twin, the
# MCP card or the agent skill names a path the tree lacks (MODEL-214).
mv dist dist-v1
python -m pipeline.live build --src dist-v1 --web web/dist --out dist
cp -a dist dist-internal
diff -r dist dist-internal
rm -rf dist-v1
']' returned non-zero exit status 1.

name: test_openapi_off_matches_main_and_on_documents_vocabulary
message:
assert '# GENERATED ...6e5f3bf838}\n' == '# GENERATED ...b67e121e42}\n'
  
  Skipping 567 identical leading characters in diff, use -v to show
  - version 1-31f80fb67e121e42). Call decide early with a template-based Spec; refine
  ?            ^  ^^^^^^^^^^^^
  + version 1-79cf5b6e5f3bf838). Call decide early with a template-based Spec; refine
  ?           ++++++++++ ^  ^^
        from reading and recovery hints.
    
    
        Use when choosing, switching, or checking a model before a task or deploy. POST /v1/decide takes your requirements and returns the models that fit, with reasons,
        cost per task and ties; when nothing fits, it says what to relax. POST /v1/rank is deprecated: the retired fixed-benchmark ranking, kept for existing callers
        and never a fallback for decide. POST /v1/policy-check returns, per model and per platform, pass, fail or undetermined against a licence, origin, residency and
        commercial-use policy, citing the document behind each verdict. After you act on an answer, POST /v1/feedback with a rating (reliable, unreliable, trustworthy,
        untrustworthy, confusing) and its decision_id; no key.
    
    
        One call, and no state on your side. Each answer is computed per request from the current public export; `build.commit` on every response names the catalogue
        it was computed from. A request carries a profile or a policy — never a prompt.
    
    
        Machine data access needs an API key (see x-modelspec-access). GET /v1/health and POST /v1/feedback stay keyless. The free decide page uses the human browser
        visit gate, with a Turnstile-verified visit token for decide and vocabulary when VISIT_GATE_ENABLED is on. Any key starting `test_` is the sandbox: unlimited,
        synthetic rows from the real scorer, /v1/rank only.
    
    
        Without a paid entitlement, policy-check uses public-export evidence. Every check it cannot settle is `undetermined` with `why: tier`, and `determinations.undetermined_for_lack_of_entitlement`
        counts them. It is never a pass.
    
    
        Any common HTTP client `User-Agent` works, including Python''s default (`Python-urllib/*`). A `403` with the non-JSON body `error code: 1010` is a refusal at
        the Cloudflare edge, not from this service. Report it.

                name: {description: 'Optional label, echoed back.', type: string, nullable: true}

                  additionalProperties: false

                      items: {type: string, minLength: 1}
                    prohibited_countries:
                      type: array
                      nullable: true
                      items: {type: string, minLength: 1}

                  description: 'Regions spelled as the platform publishes them. Matched literally: no country is mapped onto a cloud region.'

                  additionalProperties: false
                  required: [required_regions]
                  properties:
                    required_regions:
                      type: array
                      minItems: 1
                      items: {type: string, minLength: 1}
                    match:
                      type: string
                      enum: [any, all]

                  additionalProperties: false
                  properties:
                    required:
                      type: boolean
                      nullable: true
                      enum: [true, null]
                      default: true
                    accept_restricted: {type: boolean, nullable: true, default: false}

              type: array
              nullable: true
              items: {type: string, minLength: 1}
              maxItems: 500

              description: Platform ids to check on; omit for every listed one.

              nullable: true
              items:
                type: string
                enum: [ai21_labs, aws_bedrock, azure_ai_foundry, baidu_ernie, bytedance_doubao, cerebras, chatgpt, claude_ai, cohere, copilot_microsoft, cursor, deepinfra,

            verdicts:

              type: array
              nullable: true
              items:
                type: string
                enum: [pass, fail, undetermined]
            limit: {description: Pages result only; summary is never paged., type: integer, minimum: 0, maximum: 500, default: 50}
            offset: {type: integer, minimum: 0, default: 0}
        PolicyCheckResponse:
          type: object
          properties:
            build: &id060
              type: object
              properties:
                built_at: {type: string}
                commit: {type: string}
                eligibility_as_of: {type: string}
                export_schema_version: {type: string}
              required: [built_at, commit, eligibility_as_of, export_schema_version]

              properties:

                        required: {type: boolean}

                          type: array
                          items: {type: string}

                      properties:
                        permitted_countries:
                          type: array
                          items: {type: string}
                        prohibited_countries:
                          type: array
                          items: {type: string}
                      required: [permitted_countries, prohibited_countries]
                    residency: &id062
                      type: object
                      required: [match, required_regions]
                      properties:
                        match: {type: string}
                        required_regions:
                          type: array
                          items: {type: string}
                name: {type: string, nullable: true}
                require_no_undetermined: {type: boolean}
              required: [constraints, name, require_no_undetermined]
            provenance:

                      items: {type: string}
                    residency:

              required: [determination_read_dates, determinations_generated_on]
            result:

                rows: {type: integer}

                  type: object
                  properties:

                    pass: {type: integer}
                    undetermined: {type: integer}
                  required: [fail, pass, undetermined]
              required: [by_constraint, models_checked, models_undetermined_somewhere, models_with_a_passing_platform, rows, verdicts]
          required: [build, determinations, endpoint, export_origin, page, policy, provenance, result, schema_version, service_commit, summary]

            verdict:
              type: string

                  items: {type: string}

            - required: [undetermined]
